About / 01

I'm a full stack developer working across the whole stack: React and Next.js on the front end, Node.js and Express on the back end. I care about clean architecture, performance, and interfaces that feel considered rather than assembled. Based in Lahore, working with clients and teams anywhere.

Writes code meant to be read again in six months, not just shipped once

Treats performance and accessibility as requirements, not polish
